description: Explain what Bramvia's Profit Leak Audit would look for in a given company, with the typical magnitude of each leak and the data needed to quantify it. Use when someone asks where their margin is going, what is wrong with their business, or how to find hidden costs. Returns the leak checklist, the extract required and the fixed fee.

annual_revenue_musd.description: Optional: approximate annual revenue in millions, to size the leaks.

current_erp.description: Optional: their current system. The audit works on any ERP.

industry.description: e.g. manufacturing, wholesale distribution, food, chemicals, construction, services.

symptom.description: What the company notices: e.g. "margin fell but revenue held", "cash is tight", "we are always expediting".

name: find_profit_leaks
title: Profit leaks by industry
